name: Four-Layer Blameless Postmortem & Humanoid Sim-to-Real Evaluation Harness
description: Deterministic evaluation harness and four-layer blameless incident postmortem framework for humanoid robot Sim-to-Real deployment pipelines (Isaac Gym / MuJoCo -> Interface Protocol -> Unitree G1 Hardware). Reconstructs timestamp-verified incident timelines from multi-source telemetry logs and attributes Sim-to-Real failures across four orthogonal layers: (1) Simulation Environment, (2) Interface Protocol, (3) Hardware & Safety, and (4) Model Policy.
